create_tfp_compatible_distribution: create a TFP-compatible distribution wrapper from a Distrax distribution for use in TFP meta-distributions
sample_from_wrapped_distribution: sample from a TFP-compatible wrapped distribution using sample_shape and seed arguments
compute_log_prob_wrapped: compute the log probability of a value using the wrapped TFP-compatible distribution
inspect_batch_and_event_shape: inspect the batch_shape and event_shape TensorShape properties of a TFP-compatible distribution
get_experimental_local_measure: get the log probability density and TangentSpace from the experimental_local_measure method of a wrapped distribution
